shellCommands.command: cd /tmp && for i in 1 2; do echo "=== attempt $i ==="; curl -s -D /tmp/h.txt -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/projects/acme > /tmp/pf.txt; grep -iE '^(x-nextjs|cache-control|content-type)' /tmp/h.txt; echo "bytes: $(wc -c < /tmp/pf.txt)"; grep -c "Acme Storefront" /tmp/pf.txt | sed 's/^/title hits: /'; grep -c "Commerce storefront" /tmp/pf.txt | sed 's/^/details hits: /'; grep -c "Loading details" /tmp/pf.txt | sed 's/^/details-fallback hits: /'; done
curl -s -i -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/projects/acme | head -30; echo "=== server log ==="; tail -20 /tmp/next.log

curl -s -L -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/projects/acme' -o /tmp/pf.txt -D /tmp/h.txt; grep -iE 'x-nextjs|cache-control|content-type|vary' /tmp/h.txt; echo "bytes: $(wc -c < /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "title: $(grep -c 'Acme Storefront' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "details: $(grep -c 'Commerce storefront' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "fallback: $(grep -c 'Loading details' /tmp/pf.txt)"

curl -s --compressed -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/projects/acme?_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K' -o /tmp/pf.bin -D /tmp/h.txt -w 'size=%{size_download}\n'; cat /tmp/h.txt; echo "--- body (first 1500 chars) ---"; head -c 1500 /tmp/pf.bin | tr -d '\0'

ls /workspace/.next/server/app/projects/ 2>/dev/null; echo "=== shell html ==="; for f in /workspace/.next/server/app/projects/*.html; do echo "-- $f"; grep -oE "Loading project\.\.\.|Loading details\.\.\.|Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront" "$f" | sort | uniq -c; done

for f in /workspace/.next/server/app/projects/\[slug\].segments/*.rsc /workspace/.next/server/app/projects/\[slug\].segments/projects/\$d\$slug/*.rsc; do echo "-- ${f#/workspace/.next/server/app/projects/}  ($(wc -c < "$f") bytes)"; grep -aoE "Loading project\.\.\.|Loading details\.\.\.|Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront" "$f" | sort | uniq -c; done

for SEG in '/_full' '/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'; do echo "=== segment: $SEG ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: $SEG" 'http://localhost:3111/projects/acme' -o /tmp/seg.bin -D /tmp/segh.txt -w 'status/size: %{http_code} %{size_download}\n'; grep -aoE "Loading project\.\.\.|Loading details\.\.\.|Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront" /tmp/seg.bin | sort | uniq -c; done

for SEG in '/_full' '/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'; do echo "=== segment: $SEG ==="; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: $SEG" 'http://localhost:3111/projects/acme' -o /tmp/seg.bin -w 'status/size: %{http_code} %{size_download}\n'; grep -aoE "Loading project\.\.\.|Loading details\.\.\.|Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront" /tmp/seg.bin | sort | uniq -c; done

echo "=== per-link runtime prefetch (Next-Router-Prefetch: 2) ==="; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3111/projects/acme' -o /tmp/pl.bin -w 'status/size: %{http_code} %{size_download}\n'; grep -aoE "Loading project\.\.\.|Loading details\.\.\.|Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront" /tmp/pl.bin | sort | uniq -c

for slug in acme orbit; do echo "=== prefetch /projects/$slug ==="; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' "http://localhost:3111/projects/$slug" -o /tmp/pl.bin -w 'time: %{time_total}s\n'; grep -aoE "Acme Storefront|Orbit Analytics|Commerce storefront|Product analytics|Loading details\.\.\." /tmp/pl.bin | sort | uniq -c; done; echo "=== full navigation (no prefetch header) ==="; curl -s "http://localhost:3111/projects/acme" -o /tmp/nav.html -w 'time: %{time_total}s\n'; grep -oc "Commerce storefront" /tmp/nav.html | sed 's/^/details in full page: /'
pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; cd /workspace && git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
